description: Use when flying with a toddler (or baby) and dreading it: builds a flight-day plan from age + flight duration + departure time (nap-anchored timing, seat strategy lap vs ticketed, FAA-approved restraint check), packs the survival kit with quantities per flight hour (snacks, novelty items, screen downloads), predicts the 3 hardest windows and their fixes, and covers ears/crying/germs/meltdown protocols. Solves the single most-dreaded parenting travel event.
